verificationScope.explanation: Full local fixtures and fifteen native/broker commands rerun, including close deadlines, recovery control, topology, custom transport, metadata, URI, base broker, confirmations, large outgoing/incoming messages, autodelete, channel dependencies and recovery. The remaining ten historical native/broker reports retain original fingerprints and are not current-source acceptance evidence. Other 19 projects not retested.

closeDeadline.contract: An absolute close deadline bounds queued output and the close handshake. A valid call permanently disables logical recovery, never waits for unreceived publisher confirms, and destroys the adopted stream on completion or failure. Date inputs are snapshotted; null clears the close-specific timer.
closeDeadline.errors: AMQP_CLOSE_DEADLINE with timeout=true on expiry; AMQP_CONNECTION_CLOSED for an already closing/closed connection. Invalid inputs leave state unchanged.
closeDeadline.matchingScope: Result category, connection/channel closed state, recovery cancellation settlement and disabled recovery configuration only. Raw notification payloads and elapsed time are preserved outside match assertions.

differenceCategories.name: close notification API and timeout details
differenceCategories.upstream: Go NotifyClose channel closes; expired write-side deadline produced no error notification; read-side timeout produced AMQP frame-error 501 in observed runs.
differenceCategories.local: Node close event always reports its terminal error, including an expired deadline. Deadline error has code AMQP_CLOSE_DEADLINE and timeout=true.
differenceCategories.scope: Notification payload/Go channel scheduling are not counted as matched resource/result fields; raw observations retained.

differenceCategories.name: closing while a custom redial is still pending
differenceCategories.upstream: CloseDeadline waits for the in-flight custom dial to finish; 50 ms deadline does not bound the observed 350 ms wait.
differenceCategories.local: Abort-aware transport lifetime settles shutdown before the ignored factory promise; a late stream is still disposed.
differenceCategories.scope: Matched final result/cleanup fields; blocking and timing behavior explicitly differs.

closeDeadline.streamFix: Initial pre-fix development probe observed closed connection plus undestroyed generic Duplex with stalled final callback; current fixture verifies owned stream disposal after close-ok.

documentedExample.scope: JS warm execution of documented example; no cross-project or upstream performance claim

confirmedPublishSample.scope: one Windows Node/WSL loopback run; nonpersistent messages, exclusive classic queue; not a production or upstream throughput comparison

performance.scope: Local documented-example and base broker confirmation samples only; no representative close-deadline/native throughput or production-load parity claim.

Native closed-channel retry boundaries and complete listener/context scheduling equivalence
Complete Go network/deadline/context/channel scheduling and URI default/range/platform compatibility
Complete TLS state and cross-version/platform/cluster sustained workload validation
